With notation and assumptions as in Situation <REF_0001>.
If <MATH_0001> is a smooth morphism of categories cofibred
in groupoids over <MATH_0002>, then
<MATH_0003> is a smooth morphism of categories
cofibred in groupoids over <MATH_0004>.

This follows immediately from the definitions and the fact that
(<REF_0001>) preserves surjections.

<STRUCT_0001>
There are many more things you can say about the relationship between
<MATH_0001> and <MATH_0002> (in particular about the relationship
between versal deformations) and we will add these here as needed.
